name: CloudQA
description_en:
CloudQA is a web-test automation platform centered on recording user actions and replaying them as reusable checks. The current site offers both self-service tooling and an optional managed QA service; those choices involve different responsibilities for designing and maintaining tests.

This profile follows a proposed workflow from local browser recording through data-driven and API checks to failure diagnosis. It separates local execution from paid cloud capacity and keeps conflicting browser lists visible. No extension, account, test, uploaded file, API request or managed engagement was operated.
description_zh:
CloudQA 是以录制用户动作并重放为可复用检查为核心的网页测试自动化平台。当前网站提供自助工具及可选托管 QA 服务，两种选择对测试设计／维护责任的分配不同。

本文沿拟定流程评估本地浏览器录制、数据驱动／API 检查及失败诊断，区分本地执行和付费云容量，并保留冲突浏览器清单。本次未操作扩展、账户、测试、文件上传、API 请求或托管服务。

Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: A recorded path needs explicit expected outcomes
sections.title_zh: 录制路径需要明确预期结果
sections.en: The documentation organizes work into applications with base URLs, recorder steps, variables, suites and results. A click sequence captures what happened, not every requirement that should be true. Start with a short synthetic workflow and add checks for the expected result and a meaningful negative case. Verify environment parameters before replaying a write path; reusing a recording is not evidence that all business states are covered.
sections.zh: 文档按含基地址的应用、录制步骤、变量、套件及结果组织工作。点击序列记录发生了什么，不包含全部应成立需求。应从简短虚构流程开始，增加预期结果检查及有意义的反例，重放写入路径前核对环境参数。复用录制不证明覆盖全部业务状态。

sections.title_en: Existing browser sessions affect the test precondition
sections.title_zh: 已有浏览器会话影响测试前提
sections.en: Local execution uses the CloudQA Chrome extension and an account with test access. The guide distinguishes incognito from regular-window runs: regular mode can reuse cookies/session data, while incognito is intended for a fresh temporary context. It also warns against multiple local executions in one browser window. Compare the intended login state explicitly and save local edits before assuming they affect a later run. No extension or session was installed.
sections.zh: 本地执行使用 CloudQA Chrome 扩展及有测试访问权的账户。指南区分无痕与普通窗口：普通模式可复用 cookie／会话，无痕用于临时新上下文，并提醒同一窗口避免多次本地并发。应明确比较预期登录状态，并保存本地编辑后再假定后续运行使用变更。本次未安装扩展或会话。

sections.title_en: Data scope changes how many scenarios execute
sections.title_zh: 数据范围改变实际执行的场景
sections.en: The data-driven guide supports selected variables or complete input-field datasets from CSV, plus suite/environment-level data. Header names must correspond to the configured variable names. Define one expected outcome per synthetic row and estimate the total combinations before scheduling. Random values can avoid accidental reuse of a literal input, but do not prove valid test coverage or clean up the records a repeated workflow creates.
sections.zh: 数据驱动指南支持 CSV 选定变量或完整输入字段数据，也有套件／环境级数据。列头需对应已配置变量名。应为每条虚构行定义预期结果并在调度前估算组合总数。随机值可避免复用固定输入，却不证明覆盖有效，也不会自动清理重复流程创建的记录。

sections.title_en: Sending a request and checking its response are separate
sections.title_zh: 发送请求与检查响应分开
sections.en: TruAPI lets a test specify method, URL, parameters, headers/body and authentication, then add explicit response assertions. JSONPath variables can carry response values into later requests. Inspect both success and invalid-input responses before linking this to a browser flow. The documentation’s public sample URL was not invoked; no credentials or production endpoints were used. A received status alone is not a complete functional assertion.
sections.zh: TruAPI 可指定方法、URL、参数、请求头／正文及认证，再添加明确响应断言；JSONPath 变量可将响应值传入后续请求。与浏览器流程连接前需检查成功和无效输入响应。本次未调用文档公共示例地址，也未使用凭据或生产端点。只收到状态码不是完整功能断言。

sections.title_en: Inspect the first failed step before changing the test
sections.title_zh: 修改测试前先检查首个失败步骤
sections.en: Recorded results show step status, duration, screenshots and error messages, with downloadable reports. The troubleshooting guide recommends comparing the failed step with its baseline and manually checking suspected application defects. Keep the distinction between an application failure, a bad precondition and an obsolete test step. A rerun that passes does not identify the original cause, so retain the relevant evidence and environment details before the history window expires.
sections.zh: 录制结果显示步骤状态、时长、截图及错误，并可下载报告。排障指南建议将失败步骤与基线比较，人工复现疑似应用缺陷。应区分应用失败、前提错误及过时测试步骤。重跑通过不能解释原始原因，因此需在历史到期前保留相关证据及环境细节。

sections.title_zh: 官方浏览器清单当前存在冲突
sections.en: The current pricing comparison lists Chrome for Free and Chrome/Firefox/Edge for paid tiers. Yet the same page’s FAQ and the cross-browser guide still name Internet Explorer, with different custom-plan wording for Edge/Safari. These cannot establish one precise current matrix. Ask for the actual browser/version entitlement and validate the target combination before committing to coverage; mobile web emulation is not evidence of native-app access under the same license.
sections.zh: 当前定价对比列 Free 为 Chrome、付费为 Chrome／Firefox／Edge，但同页 FAQ 及跨浏览器指南仍列 Internet Explorer，对 Edge／Safari 定制方案说法也不同，无法据此形成精确现行矩阵。承诺覆盖前应核真实浏览器／版本权益并验证目标组合；移动网页模拟也不证明同许可包含原生应用。

sections.title_en: Free local runs differ from cloud capacity
sections.title_zh: 免费本地运行不同于云容量
sections.en: Kickstart is displayed at $0 with local execution and seven-day history. Scale Up displays $119/month and $99/month figures whose selected billing context needs confirmation, with one-month history and cloud runs subject to fair use. Extra cloud parallel capacity is separately purchasable; managed QA is custom-priced. Synthetic monitoring, native apps and some tunnel capabilities are labeled separate licensing. An unlimited-run label is not unlimited concurrency or every product included.
sections.zh: Kickstart 显示 $0，含本地执行和七天历史。Scale Up 同时显示每月 $119 与 $99，所选账期需确认，含一月历史且云运行受公平使用约束。额外云并发可另购，托管 QA 定制报价。合成监控、原生应用及部分隧道能力另标独立许可。无限运行不代表无限并发或包含全部产品。
